s: the original 1837 home of the pastel de nata, baked fresh all day on a secret recipe
w: The bakery that made the pastel de nata famous worldwide, baking to a closely guarded recipe since 1837 using the recipe from the nearby Jerónimos Monastery. Custard tarts arrive warm and constantly, shatteringly crisp and dusted with cinnamon and sugar. The historic tiled dining rooms fill fast, but many just eat standing outside with a coffee.
_facts: Located at Rua de Belém 84-92, 1300-085 Lisboa
Baking pastéis de nata to an original recipe since 1837
Recipe traces to the Jerónimos Monastery, near the shop
Open daily, baking continuously through the day
